teacher_info.teaching_style: I generally teach according to a goal-oriented approach. Here's a more detailed breakdown:
1. Active Listening:
Pay close attention: Focus on what the other person is saying, both verbally and nonverbally. 
Show you're listening: Nod, make eye contact, and use verbal cues like "uh-huh" or "I see". 
Ask clarifying questions: Demonstrate you're engaged by asking questions to understand their perspective. 
Reflect and paraphrase: Summarize what you've heard to ensure understanding and show you're paying attention. 
2. Engaging Questions:
Ask open-ended questions: Encourage detailed responses instead of just "yes" or "no" answers. 
Follow up on answers: Show genuine interest by asking more questions based on their responses. 
Find common ground: Look for shared interests or experiences to build rapport and keep the conversation flowing. 
Avoid leading questions: Don't steer the conversation towards your own opinions or experiences. 
3. Body Language and Tone:
Maintain eye contact: It shows you're engaged and interested in the conversation. 
Use open body language: Avoid crossing your arms or looking down, as these can signal disinterest. 
Speak clearly and at a comfortable pace: Avoid mumbling or speaking too quickly, which can make it difficult to follow. 
Be mindful of your tone: A positive and friendly tone can make conversations more enjoyable.

My name is Ashmika. I am 27 years old. I am a young, energetic and passionate individual. 

My hobbies include spending time with my niece and nephew, taking them on outdoor adventures. I have a small business called The Bling Baker. 

My other interest include practicing accounting and bookkeeping, as I have a knack for numbers and problem solving.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I am a very invested and committed teacher. I like to go the extra mile in everything I do, as I believe that kids are the future of our world, they have the potential to be anything they dream of. I would like to equip them as best I can to achieve great things.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I am patient and friendly but I am also strict and goal driven. I take pride in making my lessons fun, whilst creating a comfortable and safe environment. 

My lessons encourage students to unlock their creativity, as well as reach their personal and educational goals. 

My classes are flexible, all students are welcome regardless of age, background, proficiency level or learning goals. 

I like to start my initial lesson assessing my student and planning according to their needs, preference and current learning level. I believe communication is key, as well as focusing on problematic areas.
